Figure 3 proteomic age-prediction scatter plots, MAE bar chart, and Jaccard comparison
adjudication.rationale: All visible candidates are downstream evaluation or benchmark-result figures. They show predicted-vs-true age plots, MAE bars, accuracy bars, and Jaccard summaries, but no readable model-facing input object such as CpG beta values, clinical biomarker tables/prompts, gene-expression profiles, Olink protein profiles, pairwise comparison prompt text, or any immediate text-input/interface view. Under the decision rules, result plots cannot stand in for the actual input representation.
